rows.text: when the signed dword `+0x90` of `rcx` is greater than 0 and `0020E600(dword +0x94)` is non-null, stores `edx` to dword `+0x68` of the object a second `0020E600(dword +0x94)` call returns and then calls `003E3D70` with the result of a third `0020E600(dword +0x94)` call; otherwise it does nothing
replaces bit 22 of dword `[rcx]` with bit 0 of `edx`, sets bit 0 and stores the dword back
clears bit 27 and sets bit 28 of dword `[rcx]`, then stores `xmm1`, `xmm2` and `xmm3` to the floats at `+0x40`, `+0x44` and `+0x48`
clears bit 28 and sets bit 27 of dword `[rcx]` and stores `xmm1`, `xmm2` and `xmm3` to the floats at `+0x40`, `+0x44` and `+0x48`

calls `0020E600(dword +8 of rcx)` twice and, when the second result is non-null, calls `003E2FD0(rcx, x, xmm2, xmm3)` where `x` is the larger of `xmm1` and float `+0x18` of the first result multiplied by 1.0 (`01DFE0B8`); when the second result is null it does nothing

calls `0020E600(dword +8 of rcx)` twice and, when the second result is non-null, calls `003E3200(rcx, x, xmm2, xmm3)` where `x` is the larger of `xmm1` and float `+0x18` of the first result multiplied by 1.0 (`01DFE0B8`); when the second result is null it does nothing
clears bits 15 to 18 and 20 of dword `[rcx]` (AND `0xFFE87FFF`), sets bit 19 and stores the dword back, and stores `xmm1` to the float at `+4`

when `0020E600(dword +8 of rcx)` is non-null, replaces the low nibble of byte `+0x1D` of the object a second `0020E600(dword +8)` call returns with the low nibble of `edx` (high nibble kept); otherwise it does nothing
sets bit 8 of dword `[rcx]` and stores `xmm1` and `xmm2` to the floats at `+0x18` and `+0x1C`
sets bit 7 of dword `[rcx]` and stores `xmm1` and `xmm2` to the floats at `+0x10` and `+0x14`

when `edx` is 0, clears bit 10 and sets bits 9 and 11 of dword `[rcx]` and stores `r8d` and `r9d` to dwords `+0x20` and `+0x24`; otherwise clears bit 13 and sets bits 12 and 14 and stores `r8d` and `r9d` to dwords `+0x30` and `+0x34`

when `edx` is 0, sets bits 9 and 10 and clears bit 11 of dword `[rcx]` and copies the 16 bytes at `r8` to `+0x20`; otherwise sets bits 12 and 13, clears bit 14 and copies the 16 bytes at `r8` to `+0x30`

calls `0020E600(dword +8 of rcx)` twice and, when the second result is non-null, replaces bit 5 of byte `+0x1C` of the first result with bit 0 of `dx`; when that bit is then set, bit 0 of the byte is clear and a third `0020E600(dword +8)` call is non-null, it calls `00513150` with a fourth call's result; every other path does nothing more
rewrites dword `[rcx]` with bit 31 replaced by bit 0 of `dx` and bit 30 set (bits 0 to 29 kept)
replaces bit 26 of dword `[rcx]` with bit 0 of `dx`, sets bit 4 and stores the dword back
calls `00426220(rcx, qword +8 of rdx)` and, when it returns 0 and `003E6DA0(rcx)` is non-null, calls `003E37F0` with that result and qword `+8` of `rdx` plus `0x580`; otherwise it does nothing
zeroes word `+2`, byte `+0` and qword `+0x18` of `rcx`, stores the four floats 0, 0, 0, 1.0 (`01EF93F0`) to `+0x20`..`+0x2C`, and returns 0
zeroes word `+0` and qword `+0x10` of `rcx` and stores the four floats 0, 0, 0, 1.0 (`01EF93F0`) to `+0x20`..`+0x2C`

zeroes byte `+3`, qword `+0x14`, dword `+0x10` and word `+0` of `rcx`, stores the four floats 0, 0, 0, 1.0 (`01EF93F0`) to `+0x20`..`+0x2C` and `0x3F800000` (1.0) to dword `+4`, and stores byte `01F223A8` (0x1E in the image) minus 1 to byte `+2`
clears the high nibble of byte `+1` of `rcx`, zeroes dwords `+0x10`, `+0x40` and `+0x4C`, and zeroes bytes `+2` and `+0`

skipped.why: its whole work is the entry instruction (OR of 0x20000000 into dword [rcx]) followed by ret

notes: 003E29B0, 003E3570, 003E36A0, 005175F0: the first clause (the bit clear or set on dword [rcx], or the nibble clear on byte +1) is the entry instruction and so has no anchor; the remaining clauses are anchored. 003E30A0 / 003E3140 / 003E3720: the float or byte is read from the first 0020E600 result while the null test is on the second call's result; the rows state that literally. 00471660: 01F223A8 is a byte global, decoded as 0x1E in the image; the row gives that value only as the image value.
